show.description: A ruthless heiress and her irresistible bodyguard are trapped in a toxic game of desire, jealousy, and punishment: she loves him but trades him away before he can reject her, while he secretly worships her half-sister. When she agrees to marry a comatose heir for crores, their twisted love triangle detonates into betrayal, obsession, and a truth that destroys him.
